title: Dropping a colour on the Library shelf does not light it up
goal: A scripted run drags a colour off a shape and onto the Library shelf to save it, and the shelf never lights up to say it would take it. Saving a colour by dragging it to the shelf is one of the ways a person builds a palette, so if the shelf really has gone dark the feature is broken for them too.
notes:
Reproduced on 2026-09-08 on unmodified main (checked by stashing an unrelated harness change and rebuilding the probe; identical either way). Pre-existing.

Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/colour-off-the-shelf-walk.json
  {"error": "step 13 (dragColor): \"Library\" stayed dark for the colour off \"Fill\", and the walk expected it to takes", "status": "failed"}

Start by watching it happen: Scripts/probe-app.sh, draw a shape, drag the Fill swatch onto the Library shelf, and see whether the shelf highlights. If it does, the walk drag is landing in the wrong place; if it does not, it is a real drop target regression. (The error text also reads oddly, "expected it to takes" — worth fixing while in there.)
acceptance: Dragging a colour from a shape onto the Library shelf lights the shelf up and saves the colour when dropped, checked by hand in the probe
No walk step was weakened to make it pass
